author: REEBA ZACHARIAH
description: Noel Tata's plan for merging Tata companies seeks to maintain the private status of Tata Sons, avoiding any public listing. However, the Reserve Bank of India has already rejected previous requests to ease regulatory restrictions on Tata Sons. Additionally, potential dissent within the Tata Sons board may question the validity of this merger initiative, amplified by the Shapoorji Pallonji Group's counterarguments.
title: Walking a tightrope: 5 hurdles facing Noel Tata and an unlisted Tata Sons

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Formerly incarcerated Texas women who formed the Lioness Justice Impacted Women’s Alliance have won a major legal victory after years of documenting extreme heat inside state prisons. A federal judge ordered Texas to air-condition all prisons by 2029. Roughly 88,697 incarcerated people were housed in units without air conditioning heading into summer 2026.
title: Texas 'lionesses' win fight to air-condition prisons by 2029 for 88,000 inmates

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ballast Key, a stunning private island located near Key West, is now officially a part of the Key West National Wildlife Refuge. This crucial ownership shift aims to safeguard the island from potential developments. Once the retreat of prominent figures like David Wolkowsky, it is now vital for the biodiversity it supports, ensuring that diverse wildlife can thrive as conservation efforts continue for its preservation.
title: Key West's private Ballast Key once hosted stars, now a wildlife refuge

title: SIR tribunal judge sends quit letter to CJ, cites poor roads and long commute

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
title: ‘Court must protect liberty of accused if trial may be delayed’, says Supreme Court

author: TNN
description: The Congress Working Committee has called for the resignations of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah. Rahul Gandhi highlighted concerns about electoral roll integrity and alleged vote manipulation during elections. The CWC meeting also emphasized the urgency of restoring deleted voter registrations. Members discussed the necessity of organizing public agitation to raise awareness about electoral issues.
title: Not just CEC, PM Modi and Shah should also resign for 'vote chori', says CWC

title: Supreme Court to hear plea for CEC’s suspension, voiding SIR next week

title: Karnataka challenges high court order for SIT probe into KPSC job 'scams'

author: TNN
description: The INDIA bloc's opposition members are set to meet to formulate a plan of action against the Election Commission, centering on the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Notable leaders from Congress and TMC will attend, while DMK and AAP will be absent. This meeting follows a recent protest by Left party members at the EC headquarters demanding Kumar's resignation.
title: INDIA bloc to meet today to finalise plan for anti-SIR agitation

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Akshaj Shenoy returns to the Asian Games as captain of India's League of Legends team, three years after the side finished fifth in Hangzhou. Four players from that campaign return, joined by two Asian Games debutants. The group has since won in South Asia, competed against stronger regional opposition and joined S8UL. Now, against South Korea, Chinese Taipei and Hong Kong, they want to compete, not simply learn.
title: India's League of Legends team returns to Asiad with Hangzhou lessons

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: US President Donald Trump has officially signed an executive order that replaces the term 'Artificial Intelligence' with 'Super Intelligence.' This shift mandates federal agencies to update their communications accordingly, showcasing the evolving technological landscape. At a White House gathering with tech executives, Trump emphasized this pivotal change, with a new legal definition expected to be proposed to Congress in the near future.
title: ‘Bigger than internet’: Trump officially renames AI as ‘super intelligence’

title: ‘Michael Phelps of jumbos’: E-5 stuns forest officials, swims nearly 10km

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Hilton Bluffs project in North Carolina is facing legal challenges regarding access road routes. Local residents have filed a lawsuit against Copper Builders, objecting to pathways that intrude on private land. Even after revised plans were submitted, local authorities deemed them unsafe, leading to continued construction delays. As both sides gear up for legal hearings, the situation underscores the intense demand for housing in the area.
title: County denies Hilton Bluffs access after developer sued over roads
